body_markdown:
What if managing your learning platform was as simple as sending an email?


With Cora Admin GPT, you can administer your Affinity environment directly inside the app or over email - using plain English. Need to onboard new learners, duplicate campaigns, or generate reports? Just ask Cora.


In this recorded live session, we’ll show how Admin GPT automates everyday admin tasks so your team can focus on what matters. You’ll see how to:


‍


• Onboard new learners automatically


• Duplicate and launch training campaigns


• Run real-time reports and email them to stakeholders


‍


Watch the recording to see how natural language administration saves hours of manual work and makes managing compliance effortless.
